fields.title: 📖 Sufyān ath-Thawrī: Little food and little sleep strengthen the heart
fields.body:
🖋️ **Sufyān ath-Thawrī** said:

> ***“Sufyān ath-Thawrī warned against excessive eating and sleep, and he linked strength of the heart with restraint.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Tazkiyyah often begins with hidden habits. Whoever wants his heart must restrain his desires.

immutable.source: 📝 Abū Nuʿaym, Ḥilyat al-Awliyāʾ, Überlieferungen über Zuhd von Sufyān ath-Thawrī.
